units: Billions of nominal US dollars (amountB and totals); dollars per tax return for estimator/state means.
accountingBasis: Unified federal budget, on- and off-budget, net outlays. Category amounts are MTS table 9 functional totals; detailed program accounts use MTS table 5 unless identified otherwise. Residuals retain unitemized outlays, offsets and classification differences.

receiptDefinitions.payrollTaxB: MTS social insurance and retirement receipts: employment/general retirement, unemployment insurance, and other retirement. Broader than employee FICA alone.
receiptDefinitions.otherReceiptsB: Excise taxes + estate/gift taxes + miscellaneous receipts; customs and corporate taxes are separately listed.

taxEstimator.bracketConvention: Upper limits apply to taxable ordinary income after deductions, not gross income. null upper limit is unbounded. Rates are fractions. This is an ordinary-income, before-credit estimate, not a complete tax return calculation.
taxEstimator.averagesDefinition: A06500 (Form 1040 line 22, income tax after nonrefundable credits) * 1000 / N1 (all returns). Nominal 2023 dollars. Excludes payroll taxes, NIIT/other Schedule 2 Part II taxes, and refundable credit netting; not fiscal-year Treasury cash collections divided by returns.
taxEstimator.medianStatus: Unknown: published grouped-by-AGI totals do not identify the median of individual tax liability. Do not impute a numeric median, use the mean as a median, or compute tax on median income as median tax.

stateStatisticsDefinition: Same A06500 * 1000 / N1 definition as the national mean; includes all returns in the geography. Puerto Rico federal-return filers are a selected subset, not all island households. IRS return addresses may differ from residence; counts rounded to nearest 10.
schemaNotes: Unknown values use JSON null, never zero. Nonadditive records retain legacy identifiers without entering reconciliation sums.
Treasury dataStatus is final FY2026 MTS, not an audited financial statement. Three USAspending program splits are reported outlays with completeness/certification caveats and marked preliminary.
The dataset contains unified outlays; a dedicated-fund income-tax-only receipt needs an additional financing allocation, discussed in budget-notes.md.
